name: Air Fryer Buffalo Chicken Wraps

components.name: Buffalo Chicken
steps: Toss raw diced chicken with measured buffalo sauce, garlic powder and a little oil; chill for 15-30 minutes.
Air fry chicken in batches at 195 C for around 9-13 minutes, shaking, until 74 C in the centre.

components.name: Wraps, Cheese & Salad
steps: Measure cheddar and tortillas into four portions. Keep lettuce, carrot, tomato and ranch refrigerated in their own containers, never touching raw chicken.
For immediate serving, fill tortillas with hot cooked buffalo chicken, cheese and cold fresh vegetables and sauce.
For Sunday prep, pack chicken and tortillas separately; warm chicken, assemble with cold toppings, and crisp the closed wrap for 2-3 minutes in the air fryer if desired.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Measured 4-meal adaptation of Fabulessly Frugal air fried buffalo wraps.
Planning: Fresh assembly recommended; secondary air fryer crisp is optional.
Freezer: cooked chicken freezes well; assembled wraps with lettuce/dressing do not
Dietary: Wheat, milk, possible egg and soy in ranch.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
